title: Who Maatriva helps
subtitle: Care options for new mothers, working parents, families, and doctors.
disclaimer: Maatriva supports parents and care teams. It does not replace medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.

audiences.headline: Rest while your baby is cared for.
audiences.description: The first weeks with a newborn are physically demanding. The cradle rocks automatically when your baby stirs and alerts your phone if readings change, so you can sleep between feeds.

benefits.title: Automatic Rocking
benefits.text: The cradle sways gently when your baby starts stirring to help them fall back asleep.

benefits.title: Lullabies and Parent Voice
benefits.text: Plays recorded voice notes, white noise, and soothing sounds through the speaker.

benefits.title: Night-Vision Camera
benefits.text: Check on your baby in the dark without turning on room lights or walking over.

postpartumHelpBox.title: Postpartum Wellbeing Support
postpartumHelpBox.message: Feeling very sad, anxious, or overwhelmed after birth? You are not alone. Please speak with your doctor or healthcare provider.
postpartumHelpBox.emergencyNote: If you have thoughts of harming yourself or your baby, please seek immediate medical care.

realLifeMoment.vignette: The cradle sways gently while mom rests between feeds.
realLifeMoment.caption: Nighttime support: Gentle rocking helps baby settle back to sleep after feeding.

audiences.headline: Stay connected while you are away.
audiences.description: Check in on your baby from work through live video, receive notifications when they wake or cry, and manage caregiver permissions from your phone.

benefits.title: Live Video Streaming
benefits.text: View a live 1080p video feed and talk through two-way audio from your phone.

benefits.title: Status Notifications
benefits.text: Get alerts when your baby falls asleep, wakes up, or starts crying.

benefits.title: Access Management
benefits.text: Choose who can view the cradle video and revoke access at any time.

realLifeMoment.vignette: A quick check on your phone shows baby sleeping peacefully.
realLifeMoment.caption: Daytime check: View live video and room temperature while away from home.

audiences.headline: Coordinate care with trusted family members.
audiences.description: Invite grandparents, partners, or babysitters with time-limited QR codes so everyone knows baby's routine without conflicting instructions.

benefits.title: QR Code Invites
benefits.text: Add family helpers by scanning a QR code from the Maatriva app.

benefits.title: Controlled Permissions
benefits.text: Choose whether helpers can view video, listen to audio, or adjust rocking speeds.

benefits.title: Time-Limited Passes
benefits.text: Set temporary passes for babysitters that expire automatically when their shift ends.

realLifeMoment.vignette: Grandparents check nursery temperature before putting baby down.
realLifeMoment.caption: Family coordination: Grandparents stay involved using simple app controls.

audiences.headline: Share baby reports with your doctor.
audiences.description: Share recorded vitals and reports directly with your pediatrician or hospital team for regular checkups.
audiences.partnerCallout: For clinics and hospitals: partner with us
audiences.consultationNotice: Supports consultation discussions; does not replace physician evaluation or clinical diagnosis.

benefits.title: Connect with Doctors
benefits.text: Connect with our partner doctors or hospitals.

benefits.title: Select Time Periods
benefits.text: Share your baby's reports for a time period you select.

benefits.title: Vitals History
benefits.text: Share the baby's vitals, including the readings recorded in that period.

benefits.title: Parent Controlled
benefits.text: You decide what to share and with whom.

realLifeMoment.vignette: Doctor and parents review past week vitals chart during a routine checkup.
realLifeMoment.caption: Doctor consultation: Share recorded vitals trends during your pediatrician visit.
